feature_contract.goal: Reduce CPU-side render-state and WVP/pose inspection on full protected mono-shadow, auxiliary-render-target and occlusion draws without weakening the stereo world/effect route or GPL shader trace.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R27/R28 effect dispatch only; do not alter R9/R13 fail-closed renderer, R23 baseline, HUD/SkyGlow, DX11, DXVK, or input.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: The R27 fallback unconditionally attempted verified-world WVP/pose validation and captured five R13 render states even when both R28 and R27 independently vetoed mono-shadows, auxiliary RT and occlusion; this bypasses redundant upper checks on those draw-heavy scenes. API-work reduction only; real frame-time benefit not measured.
trace_stages: Stock OutRun effect/shadow draws enter R27 upper D3D9 draw dispatcher after R23.
R27 decides eligibility from existing mono/aux/occlusion state before expensive R28 verification and effect snapshot.
Original R13 lower draw and R9 per-eye safety ownership remain unchanged for vetoed draws; valid world effects retain existing stereo routing.
subcomponents: Short-circuit full mono-shadow and auxiliary RT effect families before redundant per-draw R28 WVP, pose and R13 render-state checks.
Short-circuit active or untrusted occlusion through unchanged R13 fail-closed chain while preserving opt-in GPL shader diagnostics and eligible binocular effect routing.
Add deterministic 32-input guard model and destructive mutation tests to canonical exact-SHA game/host CI.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Forced mono-shadow or auxiliary RT delegates directly to existing lower R13 draw without any R28 eye candidate or duplicate upper effect read.
Active/lost occlusion delegates unchanged R13 policy; GPL tracing and valid stereo world/effect checks remain unchanged.
Verify destructive mutations and pass exact-SHA DX9Ex Active Win32 game/host/package, Domain Isolation and source-impact Gates.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R27GuardWorldEffect tried R28 and R13 effect snapshot even for forced mono-shadow, aux RT and active/unavailable occlusion that both stereo routes veto.
diagnosis.root_cause: Upper R27 effect owner did not short-circuit state-known ineligible draws before expensive candidate/snapshot reads.
source_trace: Original D3D9 effect draw enters R27 hook.
R28 perspective-WVP proof and R13 effects were re-read before R27 veto.
R13 lower renderer already conservatively owns mono or occlusion and final draw.
alternatives_rejected: Do not remove R13 fallback state reading: it remains required for zero-disparity effect/occlusion.
Do not skip GPL capture even for mono effects: explicit diagnostics require snapshot and shader pair.
Do not assume query-only proxies are write-free without R26 state proof.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Short-circuit to unchanged R13 only for existing shared veto predicates when GPL trace disabled.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: 32 boolean-table combinations, 6 destructive mutations, integrated gate test pending.

performance_evidence: Source-level reduction of redundant upper-layer state/WVP checks; no measured p95/p99 data.
